Locally owned in Scottsdale

Scottsdale Sprinters is a locally owned luxury transportation company serving Scottsdale, Phoenix and all of Arizona with executive Sprinters, party buses and group coaches driven by professional chauffeurs.

Occasions: Weddings, bachelorettes, birthdays, golf days, nights in Old Town

Every occasion gets its own package and its own extras, built by people who have driven a few hundred of them. We know when the bride needs the shuttle back, and when the bachelor party does not.

Destinations: Sedona at sunrise, the Grand Canyon, Tucson wine country, the lakes

Day trips we have driven a hundred times and still love. The chauffeur knows the overlooks, the lunch stops and the way home, so the day is yours from the first mile.

The fleet: From a luxury SUV to a 56-passenger motorcoach

Sprinters, limos, party buses and coaches, detailed between every trip. Pick the one that seats your group and holds the mood you are going for; the rate is published and the deposit holds it.

Executive Sprinters, party buses, mini buses, a 56-passenger motorcoach, and a luxury Suburban — professional chauffeur service included.

About Scottsdale Sprinters

Scottsdale Sprinters, also known as Scottsdale Sprinters Buses and Limos, is a chauffeured transportation company in Scottsdale, Arizona. Chauffeured Sprinter vans come first. The fleet includes: Executive Sprinters, party buses, mini buses, a 56-passenger motorcoach, and a luxury Suburban — professional chauffeur service included. Book by the hour, or as an airport or point-to-point transfer.

Service area: Scottsdale, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Cave Creek, San Tan Valley and across Arizona.

Reviews: rated 5.0 from 511 Google reviews on Google, and 4.9 stars on Yelp.
